SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   C. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   B. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   D. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   C. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historical information as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   B. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   D. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   D. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
